scripts.services:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev: bun run services:up && turbo run dev
scripts.dev:api: bun run services:up && turbo run dev --filter=territory-nft-api
scripts.dev:api:solo: bun run services:up && cd apps/api && bun run --watch src/index.ts
scripts.dev:web:solo: bun run services:up && cd apps/web && bun run --watch src/index.ts
